senses.gloss: ch. sameto knock; to strike, punish.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 6:11">Targ. Jud. VI, 11</cite>.
Targ. Is. XXVIII, 27 (Regia: מְחַבְּטִין Pa.).—

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 28:3">Targ. Prov. XXVIII, 3</cite> <he>מטרא חָבֵיטָא</he> (not <cite ref="H00061"><he>חֲבִיטָא</he></cite>) a prostrating rain (h. text <cite ref="O00461"><he>סחף</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 17:2:3">Y. Sabb. XVII, 16ᵇ</cite> top <he>דו חָבֵיט ביה</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:6:2">Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ</cite> <cite ref="H00041"><he>חֲבַט</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="G00349"><he>זַיָּירָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 7">Gen. R. s. 7</cite>, a. e. <he>חֲבוֹט חבטך</he>, v. <cite ref="H00044"><he>חֲבָטָא</he></cite>.
Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ top חַבְטִין תורא בחילא Ash. to Ḥull. 51ᵃ (ed. בחייליה) threw an ox down with force (before slaughtering).—Part. pass. חְבִיט, f. חֲבִיטָא prostrated.

<cite ref="Ketubot 10a:8">Keth. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>מברכתא ח׳ ליה</he> is Mabrakhta (i.e. all the women of ill repute of M.) prostrated before him (so that he is an expert in such matters)? [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:4:4">Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בחביט</he>, v. preced.]
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 25:8">Targ. Y. Num. XXV, 8</cite> (ed. Amst. Pe.) he shook (the spear).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 6:1">Targ. Esth. VI, 1</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sukkah 44b:5">Succ. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ ח׳ ולא וכ׳</he> he shook it repeatedly but said no benediction.
<cite ref="Ketubot 36b:2">Keth. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>כולהו במי חַבּוּטֵי מִיחַבְּטֵי</he> all girls (even if not blind) may receive a shock by falling.
